scenario args_updates_reappend
graph x; y; a=x; b=x y; c=y x; d=[x,y] k=x
check x>a,b,c,d y>b,c,d
set_arg b 1 y
check x>a,c,d,b y>c,d,b
set_args a x
check x>c,d,b,a y>c,d,b

check x>c,b,a,d y>c,b,d
replace c y x
check x>b,a,d,c y>b,d
replace a y x
check x>b,d,c,a y>b,d
replace b x x
check x>d,c,a,b y>d,b
scenario replace_all_uses

check x>a,d y>a,b,c,d z>c
rauw y z
check x>a,d z>a,b,c,d
rauw z z
check x>a,d z>a,b,c,d
rauw x z
check z>b,c,a,d

check x>b,m0,m1 y>b,m0 m0>a a>output b>output
